preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM business_type_fields f JOIN business_types bt ON bt.id = f.business_type_id WHERE bt.code = 'PHARMACY' AND f.field_key = 'prescription_required'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO business_type_fields (business_type_id, field_key, label, field_type, required, sort_order) SELECT bt.id, 'prescription_required', 'Рецептурный', 'BOOLEAN', FALSE, 70 FROM business_types bt WHERE bt.code = 'PHARMACY' ON CONFLICT (business_type_id, field_key) DO NOTHING;
